# Platform operations and security
**Synthetic data - not a legal passport.** CIO / CISO / SRE. Server requests and dependencies require app instrumentation with service name `passport-app`. Business panels require the passport app's event contract. **No rows is unknown, not healthy.** Request counts are observed telemetry, not a measured SLA; ingestion caps, sampling and delays can hide incidents.

Use the parent Application Insights resource's **Alerts** blade for fired alert state. Use Container Apps **Metrics** and its existing Log Analytics workspace for replicas/restarts: those platform metrics are not Application Insights request telemetry. Easy Auth can reject a request before FastAPI sees it; use platform authentication logs for those denials. Workbook layout does not restrict access to the underlying traces.

content.title: App requests by route template - observed errors and p95
content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app"
| summarize observed_requests = count(), failures = countif(success == false), unauthorized = countif(resultCode in ("401", "403")), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by route = name
| order by failures desc

content.title: SQL, Blob and Foundry dependency health - no SQL text or URLs with query strings
content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app"
| summarize observed_calls = count(), failures = countif(success == false), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by type, target
| order by failures desc

content.title: Latest outbox backlog per series - state, not a sum of retry events
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name == "passport.series.snapshot"
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend series = tostring(customDimensions.series_id)
| where isnotempty(series)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by series
| project series, timestamp, freshness = iff(timestamp < ago(15m), "STALE - check worker", "Recent snapshot"), pending = tolong(customMeasurements.outbox_pending), oldest_pending_minutes = todouble(customMeasurements.oldest_outbox_minutes)

content.title: Connector messages by type, result and reason code
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name == "connector.message"
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| summarize observed_messages = count() by message_type = tostring(customDimensions.message_type), result = tostring(customDimensions.result), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code)
| order by observed_messages desc

content.title: Lifecycle events recorded, already recorded or quarantined
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name == "lifecycle.event"
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| summarize observed_events = count() by event_type = tostring(customDimensions.event_type), result = tostring(customDimensions.result), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code)
| order by result asc, observed_events desc

content.title: Passport views served by role group and field set - no viewer identity
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name == "view.served"
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| summarize views_served = count() by role_group = tostring(customDimensions.role_group), field_set = tostring(customDimensions.field_set), bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc

content.title: App-observed access denials and injection holds - reason codes, no evidence content
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and name in ("access.denied", "gate.failed")
| where tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| summarize observed_events = count() by event_type = name, route = tostring(customDimensions.route_template), role = tostring(customDimensions.actor_role), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code)

content.title: Outbox retries and failed ledger verification - trace IDs for investigation
content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where cloud_RoleName == "passport-app" and tostring(customDimensions["dbp.schema_version"]) == "2"
| where name == "outbox.retry" or (name == "ledger.verified" and tostring(customDimensions.result) == "failure")
| extend event = tostring(customDimensions.event_id)
| where isnotempty(event)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by name, event
| project timestamp, event_type = name, command_id = tostring(customDimensions.command_id), reason_code = tostring(customDimensions.reason_code), attempt = tolong(customMeasurements.attempt), trace_id = operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
| take 200
